svg.title: FoodHub complete use case diagram
svg.desc: UML use case diagram of FoodHub. Guest, Registered User, Customer, Restaurant Manager, Rider and Administrator with their use cases, include and extend relationships, and the email service and Google Maps as supporting actors.
svg.text: JPG, PNG, WebP up to 2 MB
Solid line: the actor takes part in the use case
«include»: the base use case always does this step. «extend»: an optional or conditional addition to the base
Hollow arrow: the role is also a Registered User and can do everything in the Account group
